projection.note: A projection from the measurements and the assumptions it lists, never a measurement (EVL-13).

assumptions.basis: Assumed: a request, a clarification or a confirmation, and a follow-up; the evaluation's scripts will replace it (ADR-0005)
ADR-0004's graph: the router, one extraction, and the reply
Assumed: instructions, the turn's formatted facts, and the conversation so far; no prompt caching

assumptions.unit: output tokens per model call, reasoning included
DynamoDB read request units per turn
assumptions.basis: Assumed: the session binding, the checkpoint, and each tool's read of the tools' data and the overlay

assumptions.unit: DynamoDB write request units per turn
assumptions.basis: Assumed: 18 writes of up to 2 KB (checkpoints per node, the execution record's events)

assumptions.unit: seconds a runtime session stays up after its last request
seconds to the first byte on a new runtime session

profiles.basis: As measured: the busiest day's contacts spread evenly over its 24 hours, since no table has a daily cycle
Assumed, not measured: the busiest day's contacts within 12 hours, twice the hourly rate, as a contact center with a daily cycle would see

scenarios.basis: Contacts that already arrive as a chat (App, Web Chat, WhatsApp), where the agent would sit; chats record no handle time, so a conversation lasts the mean handle time of all contacts
The reason category nearest card support, with its own mean handle time; a bracket, not a measure, since contacts can't be tied to a workflow (ADR-0003)
Every contact, whatever its reason or channel: the upper bound
